sql: SELECT "budget"."link_to_event" AS e, AVG("budget"."remaining") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("budget"."spent" - "budget"."amount") AS REAL) / "budget"."amount")) AS m2 FROM "budget" GROUP BY "budget"."link_to_event" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: budget.relative difference of amount spent in category from amount budgeted
why: average of budget remaining (amount minus spent) per event (by link_to_event)
